Enclosing class:
CameraInputDevice
public static class CameraInputDevice.FitScreenPreviewDisplayMode extends CameraInputDevice.PreviewDisplayMode
Class representing the display mode used to fit the preview to the screen on the shortest size. As parameter it is possible to set the positioning for portrait and landscape.
